purpose: terminal ioctl requests for the pseudo-terminal pair and the foreground process group, and the 32-bit request mask every _IOR request needed
platform: monitor capstone-sbi a810177, capstone-qemu ac2837aa0e, modcapstone d60365e, launcher capstone-exec built from this commit (-Wall -Wextra -O2), musl 1.2.5 with musl-patches/; contract images and cpython.dom rebuilt from this tree; perl.dom and mruby.dom from delegation-signals

native_ctest.new: delegate-pty: TIOCSPTLCK, TIOCGPTN (also in the sign-extended form musl sends), TIOCGPGRP through the buffer entry; TIOCSTI and the integer entry for TIOCGPTN refused

cpython.pty-smoke.py: PASS: os.openpty, /dev/pts/0, isatty, bytes across the pair, tcgetpgrp on the slave ENOTTY (not the controlling terminal)

finding: before the mask, TIOCSPTLCK (0x40045431) crossed and TIOCGPTN (0x80045430) answered ENOSYS: musl's ioctl takes the request as int, so every request with bit 31 set arrived sign-extended and missed both the libc's size table and the launcher's allowlist; the kernel reads an unsigned int, and both sides now mask before looking the request up
method: one guest boot on this launcher; contract pty mode through application-supervisor --mode pty; run.py --repeat 1; run-binfmt.py; run-signals.py; CPython with PYTHONHOME=/mnt/host/py
